findings.detail: Four disclosed current-period equity positions are absent from pipeline output, including one with fair value 1,078 and three zero-fair-value positions with disclosed share counts.

rationale: The March 31, 2026 source schedule at table 22 directly lists all four flagged issuers as position rows. SEM Holdings has 1,100 shares, cost 1,100, and fair value 1,078; Thrasio, SDB HOLDCO, and Pluralsight each have disclosed share counts despite dash fair values. Thus zero fair value does not make them non-positions, and omission of all four from pipeline output is a grounded extraction/completeness error. No monetary grand-total residual is needed because the four source rows directly localize the defect.
